Inspect the supplied codebase and identify its core component: the connected set of responsibilities around which the application's main behavior and state are organized. Generate a single ASCII tree diagram showing that core component, its main parts, and their relationships. Choose the scope and level of detail that best explain the codebase. Ground the diagram in the source code.

Structure the tree as a decomposition of the core component:
  - Top-level branches are the core's main parts, not 3+1 categories. Each part appears in exactly one place.
  - Depth always means "is part of": a child is contained in, held by, or owned by its parent.
  - Place call, data-dependency and ownership lines under the part where they happen, with -> lines to the parts they reach. Do not give a flow its own top-level branch.
Cover breadth before depth:
  - Name every major subsystem of the core at depth 1-2, even in one line, before detailing any of them.
  - When a part has substantial structure of its own, give it a child line naming its sub-parts, even if you do not expand them.
  - Do not detail one part down to field layouts, allocators or buffers while another major part remains a single line.

Here is the "3+1" model of conceptual codebase models:
1. [REPLACED] Containment	      where code lives
2. [REPLACED] Lexical scope	    which names code can see
  -> *collapse* into 1. Modular structure
    I want to collapse Containment / Lexical scope into a single category, called modular structure, which:
    - abstracts out the source file level organization
      - but retains boundaries and visibility: what a component exposes versus keeps internal
    - retains dependency graph
    - groups components into higher level, logic-semantical categorizations
3. Call (dynamic)     which activation invoked which
4. Ownership          responsibility for state, storage, resources, and their lifetimes: who creates, retains, changes, or releases them
1. [SPECIAL] Data dependency   is a different kind of thing. It isn’t a fifth organizational choice; it is the record of what actually needs what for the program to compute its result. It’s a graph, and it exists before you decide how to organize anything.

Keep the following in mind when generating your diagram:
  - there should be 60/40 between code refs and nat lang

Few-shot examples (synthetic style references, not source facts):
Example 1: Incremental compiler
Incremental compiler -- reuse follows the module dependency graph
|
|-- [M] BuildGraph connects source modules to their compilation artifacts
|   |-- modules[moduleId]: ModuleUnit
|   |   |-- sourceHash -> immutable source bytes
|   |   |-- imports[] -> resolved module identities
|   |   `-- interfaceHash -> names and types visible to consumers
|   `-- units[unitId]: AnalysisUnit
|       |-- mutually dependent modules share one unit
|       `-- dependencies[] -> units whose interfaces must be available first
|
|-- [C] compileUnit(unitId) resolves one reusable result
|   |-- [D] member source hashes + dependency interfaces + compiler options
|   |   `-- analysisKey, including the compiler implementation version
|   |-- ArtifactCache.lookup(analysisKey)
|   |   |-- Hit -> recover typed modules and diagnostics
|   |   `-- Miss -> analyze the unit
|   |       |-- [C] Parser.parse(source) -> syntax with source spans
|   |       |-- [C] Binder.bind(syntax, dependencyInterfaces)
|   |       |   `-- Scope
|   |       |       |-- declarations[name] -> local Symbol
|   |       |       |-- parent -> enclosing lexical scope
|   |       |       `-- exports -> symbols visible across the module boundary
|   |       `-- [C] TypeChecker.check(boundUnit) -> typed modules + diagnostics
|   `-- Successful analysis -> Emitter.emit(typedModules, target)
|       |-- [D] typed modules + target version + emission options -> objectKey
|       `-- ObjectArtifact
|           |-- object code / exported interface / source map
|           `-- [O] ArtifactCache retains complete immutable entries
|               `-- consumers borrow artifacts; eviction follows cache policy
|
|-- [C] rebuild(changedPaths) propagates only relevant changes
|   |-- Capture new source hashes and resolve changed imports
|   |   `-- [D] updated graph -> regroup cycles and order affected units
|   |-- Reanalyze affected units
|   |   |-- Exported interface changed -> invalidate dependent analysis keys
|   |   `-- Interface unchanged -> consumers can reuse their typed modules
|   `-- [D] reachable object hashes + runtime + linker options -> bundleKey
|       `-- Linker.link(objects) produces the executable bundle
|           `-- changed implementation can require linking without retyping consumers
|
`-- [O] BuildScheduler controls transient execution
    |-- ready queue -> units whose dependency results are available
    |   `-- independent units may run concurrently
    |-- running[unitId] -> task + worker lease
    |   |-- [C] invoke compileUnit(unitId)
    |   `-- task settlement returns the worker lease
    |-- cancel(buildId)
    |   `-- stop scheduling -> signal tasks -> await settlement -> release snapshot
    `-- BuildResult retains bundle references and source-located diagnostics
        `-- [D] diagnostic spans + captured sources -> stable reported locations

Example 2: Telemetry ingestion service
Telemetry ingestion service
|
|-- [M] IngestGateway accepts batches from device connections
|   |-- accept(connection, envelope): BatchReceipt
|   |   |-- [D] credentials + device registry -> authorized tenant/device
|   |   `-- [C] decode -> validate envelope -> PartitionRouter.route(batch)
|   |       |-- Partition key = tenantId + deviceId
|   |       `-- One device's batches reach the same ordered partition
|   |-- [O] Retains connection state until disconnect
|   |   |-- pending[batchId] -> receipt waiter
|   |   `-- socket close detaches waiters; accepted work can still finish
|   `-- Admission limit
|       |-- available capacity -> enqueue batch
|       `-- full partition queue -> return retryable rejection
|
|-- [O] PartitionWorker owns one partition's ingestion progress
|   |-- Retained state
|   |   |-- queue: BoundedQueue<AcceptedBatch>
|   |   |   `-- accepted batches wait here before processing
|   |   |-- checkpoint: PartitionCheckpoint
|   |   |   |-- partitionId / committedOffset
|   |   |   `-- lastSequence[deviceId] -> latest committed device sequence
|   |   `-- lease: PartitionLease
|   |       |-- ownerId / epoch / expiresAt
|   |       `-- [D] current epoch -> authority to commit new progress
|   |
|   |-- [C] run() drains the queue one batch at a time
|   |   `-- process(batch)
|   |       |-- Establish batch identity
|   |       |   |-- key = tenantId + deviceId + batchId
|   |       |   `-- [C] EventStore.lookupReceipt(key)
|   |       |       |-- Same payload hash -> return committed receipt
|   |       |       |-- Different payload hash -> reject identity conflict
|   |       |       `-- Missing receipt -> prepare a new commit
|   |       |
|   |       |-- Normalize measurements
|   |       |   `-- [C] SchemaRegistry.resolve(batch.schemaVersion)
|   |       |       |-- [M] Exposes versioned field and unit definitions
|   |       |       `-- [D] raw samples + exact schema -> Measurement[]
|   |       |           |-- identity: tenantId / deviceId / sequence
|   |       |           |-- observation: timestamp / metric / value / unit
|   |       |           `-- provenance: batchId / schemaVersion / payloadHash
|   |       |
|   |       |-- Check sequence continuity
|   |       |   |-- [D] firstSequence + checkpoint.lastSequence[deviceId]
|   |       |   |   `-- next expected sequence or a detected gap
|   |       |   |-- Contiguous -> stage measurements
|   |       |   `-- Gap or overlap -> reject without advancing checkpoint
|   |       |
|   |       `-- Commit and acknowledge
|   |           |-- [C] EventStore.commit(batch, checkpoint, lease.epoch)
|   |           |   |-- [D] measurements + batch identity + next checkpoint
|   |           |   |   `-- one durable transaction
|   |           |   `-- Stale lease epoch -> reject the former owner
|   |           `-- After confirmed commit
|   |               |-- Install returned checkpoint
|   |               `-- Resolve gateway waiters with BatchReceipt
|   |                   `-- receipt confirms storage, not downstream indexing
|   |
|   `-- Lease loss or shutdown
|       |-- [C] Stop admission and stop dequeuing new work
|       |-- In-flight commit may have an uncertain outcome
|       |   `-- retry resolves through its durable batch receipt
|       `-- [O] Release queue entries and detach remaining waiters
|           `-- next owner restores progress from EventStore
|
|-- [M] EventStore binds stored events to durable progress
|   |-- [M] Exposes commit / lookupReceipt / restoreCheckpoint / scan
|   |-- Internal transaction
|   |   |-- Verify current partition lease epoch
|   |   |-- Append measurements with partition offsets
|   |   |-- Insert receipt under the unique batch identity
|   |   `-- Advance PartitionCheckpoint in the same commit
|   |       `-- failure rolls back events, receipt and checkpoint together
|   |-- [O] Retains the durable event log and retry receipts
|   |   |-- worker restarts leave both intact
|   |   `-- receipt retention defines the supported retry horizon
|   `-- scan(partitionId, afterOffset): EventPage
|       `-- [D] committed log + cursor -> ordered events and next cursor
|
`-- [M] ProjectionHost maintains independently rebuildable read models
    |-- [O] consumers[name]: ProjectionConsumer
    |   |-- cursor[partitionId] -> last applied event offset
    |   |-- handler: ProjectionHandler
    |   `-- cancellation + poll subscription
    |
    |-- Registered consumers
    |   |-- LatestReading
    |   |   |-- [D] device/metric + sequence -> newest accepted value
    |   |   `-- older replayed events cannot replace a newer reading
    |   `-- HourlySummary
    |       |-- [D] metric + observation timestamp -> aggregation bucket
    |       `-- count / sum / minimum / maximum
    |           `-- late observations update their original time bucket
    |
    |-- [C] poll() -> EventStore.scan() -> handler.apply(page)
    |   `-- Projection transaction
    |       |-- Apply only offsets beyond the stored consumer cursor
    |       `-- Save changed rows and cursor atomically
    |           `-- crash before commit -> safely read the same page again
    |
    `-- rebuild(name, newVersion)
        |-- [O] Create separate projection tables and fresh cursors
        |-- [C] Replay retained events while the current version serves reads
        `-- [D] rebuilt cursors + captured log positions -> readiness
            `-- switch readers after catch-up; retire the previous tables

Example 1 places two operations (compileUnit, rebuild) at the top level; in your tree, nest operations under the part that owns them.
Use the examples as a varied pool of representational choices. Let the supplied evidence determine depth, branching, density, and relationship types; do not copy their domain facts, exact shapes, counts, or require every tag.

Tree validation: Start with one root title, followed by a connector-only line. Place all other content beneath explicit branches. Do not insert annotations, references, legends, or explanatory text between the root title and its first branch.

Root title
|
|-- First component
|   `-- Supporting detail
`-- Second component

Before returning, verify that every branch belongs to the single root.

Return a JSON object with exactly one field, "ascii", containing the diagram string. Return exactly one ASCII tree with one root, printable ASCII characters, spaces and LF newlines. No Markdown fences or surrounding prose. The complete tree must fit within 20000 characters. Do not add separate side diagrams.

{"ascii":"Source-grounded diagram workspace -- edit, explore, generate and review versioned canvases
|
|-- Workspace orchestration and session ownership
|   |-- MappingWorkspacePage (src/features/mapping/MappingPage.tsx)
|   |   |-- Active document, explorer, tool windows, transfers and save/reload coordination
|   |   |-- MappingDiagramExplorer, MappingSubmenu, FloatingPane and WindowPanel
|   |   `-- Mounts canvas/source/review surfaces -> session stores; commands -> controllers
|   |-- CanvasWorkspace (src/features/mapping/workspace/canvasWorkspace.ts)
|   |   |-- Owns drafts, controller registry, subscriptions and dirty-scene index
|   |   |-- setDrafts(): creates sessions; disposes replaced/removed sessions
|   |   `-- CanvasSession (workspace/canvasSession.ts)
|   |       |-- Read-only document, presentation, selection, controls, geometry and status stores
|   |       |-- Saved baseline determines dirty state; cursorCopy owns pending pasted content
|   |       |-- MappingDocumentController (domain/mapping/workspace/mappingDocumentController.ts)
|   |       |   |-- Owns current snapshot, editing-context handle and optional live-editor driver
|   |       |   |-- applyUpdate(), select(), commitDocument(), canvasView(): semantic command boundary
|   |       |   |-- Operations: diagram edits, source mappings, edges, highlights, alternatives and layout
|   |       |   |-- Validates versions; reconciles connections, jumps and selection after edits
|   |       |   `-- Recorded changes -> DefaultCanvasHistoryService; notifications -> session stores
|   |       `-- onCommit() -> CanvasWorkspace.onPersist(); dispose() detaches observers
|   `-- Workspace transfer coordination (MappingPage.tsx; domain/core/diagrams/canvasTransfer.ts)
|       |-- Copy/move selected diagrams; retain cross-document transaction records
|       `-- Linked undo/redo -> source and destination controllers, not one editor alone
|
|-- Diagram semantics and version history (domain/core/diagrams/)
|   |-- Diagram / DiagramContent (diagram.ts; diagramContent.ts)
|   |   |-- Immutable identity/revision, ASCII content, source context, highlights and jumps
|   |   |-- buildDiagramContent(), asciiTree, asciiGraph and diagramContentNodes
|   |   |   `-- ASCII + pinned parser version -> stable parsed structure and selectable nodes
|   |   `-- DiagramSourceContext: content hash, source binding, mappings and evidence
|   |       `-- diagramSource().forSelection() joins diagram regions -> source ranges
|   |-- Canvas document model (domain/mapping/workspace/mappingGrid.ts)
|   |   |-- MappingGridDocument: LineGridScene, edges, jumps, presentations and agent contexts
|   |   |-- LineGridScene: container/diagram instances reference versioned diagram content
|   |   `-- Alternatives, revision selections and reviews retain competing diagram versions
|   |-- Canvas presentation model (mappingWorkspace.ts; displayModel.ts)
|   |   |-- MappingCanvasState: selection, diagram views, display ownership tree and controls
|   |   |-- DisplayState: selection regions, projected panes, conversations and detail panes
|   |   `-- SelectionState owns membership; captured regions and menu focus are separate
|   `-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService (canvasHistoryService.ts)
|       |-- WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory> isolates each editing context
|       |-- CanvasHistory: checkpoints, past/future navigation, saved views and generation candidates
|       |-- diagramRevisionStore: retained immutable revisions used by document projections
|       |-- append(), navigate(), forkContext(), adopt(), prepareTransfer()
|       `-- persistenceChanges() -> incremental revision/checkpoint records for storage
|
|-- Interactive canvas and spatial presentation (src/features/mapping/)
|   |-- MappingEditorCanvas / MappingEditorRuntime (tldraw/)
|   |   |-- tldraw Editor owns live geometry, camera and native undo navigation
|   |   |-- shapeProjection + MappingShapeUtil: diagrams, panes, groups and connections
|   |   |-- settle() -> controller.commitEditorGesture(); semantic checkpoints -> native history
|   |   `-- Pointer/camera frames stay local; completed gestures publish application changes
|   |-- CanvasRuntime, LocalAnchorStore and NativeRoutingStore (tldraw/)
|   |   |-- Selection gestures, measured anchors, connection geometry and routing worker
|   |   `-- DiagramShapeContent, FloatingShapeContent and DiagramSidePanelContent render projections
|   |-- MappingPocSelectionCanvas (canvas/MappingCanvas.tsx)
|   |   |-- CanvasSelectionLayer, CanvasSelectionActions, SelectionEffectsLayer and CursorCopyOverlay
|   |   |-- Node/region selection, subtree controls, highlights, clipboard and projection actions
|   |   `-- User actions -> MappingDocumentController; selected evidence -> code/source panes
|   `-- ProjectionLayoutPanel and domain layout helpers
|       |-- Grid placement, floating panes, side panels and connection routing
|       `-- Calculated layout + expected version -> controller.commitProjectionLayout()
|
|-- Source exploration, navigation and compacted views
|   |-- SourceWindowPanel / SourceCodePane / code-panel (src/features/mapping/)
|   |   |-- File browsing, mapped code ranges, source navigation and projection panes
|   |   `-- Selected content nodes + DiagramSourceContext -> displayed source evidence
|   |-- SourcePaneViewState (src/features/mapping/source-pane/sourcePaneViewState.ts)
|   |   |-- Owns per-document/per-pane scroll state and captured cameras
|   |   `-- captureDisplay(), captureCamera() -> WorkspacePersistence, outside semantic edits
|   |-- ProjectSourceService (application/core/source/projectSource.ts)
|   |   |-- files(), source(), definitions(); resolves the diagram's repository/corpus binding
|   |   `-- Reads -> CorpusAccess; optional definition lookup -> ProjectLanguageService
|   |-- DiagramSearchService / useDiagramSymbolSearch (src/features/mapping/search/)
|   |   |-- Diagram text search, symbol search and focused result highlighting
|   |   `-- Results -> workspace focusBox and canvas navigation
|   `-- FileCompactionService (application/mapping/compaction/)
|       |-- fileCompactionWorkflow, agent runtime and FileCompactionStore
|       `-- Source-validated compacted representations -> CoreApplication/project catalog
|
|-- Agent-assisted editing and generation
|   |-- PromptComposerCoordinator (src/features/mapping/prompt-composer/)
|   |   |-- Owns prompt drafts, captured references, exact retry requests and polling timers
|   |   |-- Create/edit/extend operations; subtree edits and alternative generation
|   |   `-- DiagramEditClient -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService; results -> revision receivers
|   |-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService (application/mapping/agent/sessionService.ts)
|   |   |-- Owns live attachments, request receipts, execution runs and chat bindings
|   |   |-- DiagramEditService + DiagramBatchService: generate and apply revision proposals
|   |   |-- AgentContextService + AgentContextLibrary: resolve reusable source/context snapshots
|   |   |-- CanvasApiProjection + CanvasReadAliases expose tool-facing canvas identities
|   |   `-- Validated tool calls -> CanvasSessionPort; execution -> QuickJsAgentRuntime
|   |-- Live canvas connection
|   |   |-- useAgentCanvasBridge (src/features/mapping/agent/): register, poll, execute and reply
|   |   |-- CanvasSessionBridge (infrastructure/mapping/agent/): server/browser command bridge
|   |   |-- LiveCanvasService + liveCanvasPublisher: availability and selection updates
|   |   `-- Received mutations -> workspace controllers; cleanup unregisters the browser instance
|   |-- AgentChatService (application/mapping/agent-chat/)
|   |   |-- AgentChatPanel, ChatDiagramTools, MCP binding, Codex connection and FileChatStore
|   |   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge owns isolated generation controllers and mutation receipts
|   |   `-- Isolated candidates -> same domain commands/history, without changing browser selection
|   `-- SelectionService / LocalChatService (application/mapping/selection/; chat/)
|       |-- Selection-scoped generation and conversations; Pi/Codex runtime adapters
|       `-- Captured ASCII + selection + source evidence -> validated agent requests
|
|-- Change review, comparisons and generation evaluation
|   |-- ChangeSessionService (application/mapping/changes/changeSessionService.ts)
|   |   |-- Baseline/proposed documents, pinned Git context, DiffTree and request receipts
|   |   |-- Proposal edits -> headless MappingDocumentController, separate from live drafts
|   |   `-- accept(): check proposal/live versions -> projectCatalogs.acceptCanvasChanges()
|   |-- DiffSessionWorkflowService + PushIntegrationService
|   |   |-- Repository-diff generation workflow, persisted runs and Git push integration
|   |   `-- Captured repository hunks + canvases -> ChangeSessionService proposals
|   |-- Review surfaces (src/features/mapping/changes/; canvas-views/; treemap/)
|   |   |-- ChangeSessionPreview, DiffTreePanel, CanvasViewDiffPreview and treemap views
|   |   `-- CanvasViewControls / GeneratedCanvases -> saved views and generated candidates
|   `-- Evaluation subsystem (application/mapping/evals/; compare/)
|       |-- CompareSessionService + ComparisonGenerationService: pinned comparison canvases
|       |-- EvalRunService: prepared inputs, generation cells, running tasks and result writes
|       |-- EvalPromptService, EvalReferenceService, LayoutTemplateService and ReferenceGenerationService
|       |-- JudgementService, ExperimentService and roll-up materialization
|       `-- GeneratedCanvasCatalog -> reusable outputs; EvalsPage exposes the separate /evals surface
|
`-- Persistence, publication and application wiring
    |-- WorkspacePersistence (src/features/mapping/workspace/workspacePersistence.ts)
    |   |-- Owns per-session persistence cursors and subscriptions
    |   |-- Controller deltas + metadata + captured view state -> deduplicated record batches
    |   `-- Workspace index retains active document and cross-canvas transfers
    |-- WorkspaceStorage / RecordStorage (src/features/mapping/workspace/)
    |   |-- One storage worker per workspace; load, write, flush and restore
    |   `-- Record batches -> /api/mapping/workspace/records
    |-- MappingWorkspaceService (application/mapping/workspace/workspaceService.ts)
    |   |-- Project-scoped loadRecords(), applyBatch(), portableExport() and prepareImport()
    |   |-- MappingWorkspaceStore owns WorkspaceRecordStore (infrastructure/mapping/persistence/)
    |   `-- Workspace UI records remain separate from published representation revisions
    |-- MappingDiagramService / project catalog (application/mapping/diagrams/; core/representations/)
    |   |-- Initialize, save, publishCheckpoint and delete published diagrams
    |   `-- DiagramStore / DiagramPersistence -> durable catalogs and diagram revision storage
    `-- App and createBackend (src/app/App.tsx; src/server/app/bootstrap.ts)
        |-- App creates client services; MappingPocPage is the default application surface
        |-- createBackend connects services, repository stores, runtimes and HTTP routes
        `-- dispose() stops agent/evaluation tasks, bridges and optional language services"}
